Root cause of agent-team.ts preference persistence bug: `sanitizeJson()` (line 110) replaces ALL newline characters in the raw JSON file with literal `
` escape sequences, including structural whitespace newlines between JSON tokens. Since `savePreferences()` (line 546) writes pretty-printed JSON with `JSON.stringify(merged, null, 2) + "
"`, the saved file has real newlines. On the next `loadPreferences()` call, `sanitizeJson()` converts those structural newlines to literal `
`, producing `{
  "viewMode": "compact"
}
` which is invalid JSON. The `catch {}` on line 531 silently swallows the parse error and returns `{}`, so viewMode falls back to the default "cards". The bug is that sanitizeJson is designed for sanitizing JSON string values but is being applied to the entire JSON document.
